spec.description: Flux GitOps: Ready, failing and suspended objects from the Flux Operator (flux_resource_info), plus reconcile rate and duration from the Flux controllers.

spec.expr: count(max by (kind, namespace, name) (flux_resource_info{kind=~"$kind", namespace=~"$namespace"})) or vector(0)

spec.description: Flux objects the Flux Operator reports (Kustomizations, HelmReleases, sources ...).
spec.title: Objects

spec.expr: count(max by (kind, namespace, name) (flux_resource_info{kind=~"$kind", namespace=~"$namespace", ready="True"})) or vector(0)

spec.expr: count(max by (kind, namespace, name) (flux_resource_info{kind=~"$kind", namespace=~"$namespace", ready="False", suspended="False"})) or vector(0)

spec.description: Not suspended and Ready=False: the last reconcile failed. DependencyNotReady counts here too.
spec.title: Failing

spec.expr: count(max by (kind, namespace, name) (flux_resource_info{kind=~"$kind", namespace=~"$namespace", ready="Unknown", suspended="False"})) or vector(0)

spec.description: Not suspended and Ready=Unknown: a reconcile is in progress (or stuck waiting on health checks).
spec.title: Reconciling

spec.expr: count(max by (kind, namespace, name) (flux_resource_info{kind=~"$kind", namespace=~"$namespace", suspended="True"})) or vector(0)

spec.description: Objects with spec.suspend set; Git changes do not reach them.
